parameters.query: SELECT h.id, h.status, h.reason, h.assigned_to, h.created_at FROM handoffs h JOIN conversations c ON c.id = h.conversation_id AND c.business_id = h.business_id WHERE h.conversation_id = $1::uuid AND h.status = 'pending' LIMIT 1;
UPDATE conversations SET status = 'waiting_agent', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, status, business_id;

INSERT INTO handoffs (business_id, conversation_id, status, reason, assigned_to) SELECT c.business_id, c.id, 'pending', $2, CASE WHEN $3 IS NULL OR btrim($3) = '' OR lower(btrim($3)) = 'null' THEN NULL WHEN $3 ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN $3::uuid WHEN lower(btrim($3)) IN ('unassigned', 'none', 'n/a') THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT su.id FROM staff_users su WHERE su.business_id = c.business_id AND su.status = 'active' AND (su.display_name ILIKE btrim($3) || '%' OR su.first_name ILIKE btrim($3) OR su.last_name ILIKE btrim($3) OR su.email::text ILIKE btrim($3) || '%') ORDER BY su.display_name LIMIT 1) END FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, status, reason, assigned_to, created_at;

INSERT INTO audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id, action, performed_by, performed_by_type, description, new_values, metadata) VALUES ('conversation', $1::uuid, 'human_handoff_requested', NULL, 'ai', $2, jsonb_build_object('handoff_id', $3::uuid), jsonb_build_object('request_id', $4, 'timestamp', NOW())) RETURNING id;
